title: F5_probe_installation -- confirmation on TEST
frozen_before: any TEST-split quantity for F5 was computed. TEST has not been read for this family.

provenance.never_pool: basket is a SEPARATE preregistration; this one is button only

history.discovery: TRAIN, 67 domains / 670 slots. CONT-ENTRY 059. rho_loo=+0.6241, nested lambda=1e2 in 67/67 folds, within-domain permutation p=0.0050.
history.selection: VALIDATION, 23 domains / 230 slots. CONT-ENTRY 061. rho=+0.6784, positive in 22/23 domains, permutation p=0.00050, lambda NOT retuned.
history.confirmation: TEST -- NOT YET RUN. This document specifies it.

specification.estimator: ridge regression, dual form, closed form alpha = (K + lambda*I)^-1 y, prediction = X_test @ X_fit.T @ alpha
specification.fit_population: TRAIN + VALIDATION domains (90 total, minus the 3 EXCLUDED_DOMAINS), pooled
specification.target: y_install on the semantic_one_word channel, cell C; the semantic_forced_choice channel is FORBIDDEN (mandate 4)
specification.centering: x and y are centred WITHIN DOMAIN, separately in the fit and the eval population
specification.scoring: Spearman rho between predicted and actual within-domain-centred y over all TEST slots
specification.no_retuning: lambda, site, layer and cell are FIXED by this document and may not be re-chosen on TEST

null.procedure: labels permuted WITHIN domain on TEST; the predictor is FIXED (fit on TRAIN+VALIDATION) and is NOT refit
null.note: because the predictor is fixed, permuting labels is the complete null; the C-CONT-002 refit requirement applies only when the fit is inside the resampled loop

decision_rule.CONFIRMED: rho_test > 0 AND permutation p < 0.05 AND per-domain rho positive in >= 60% of TEST domains
decision_rule.point_prediction: rho_test in [0.55, 0.70]; the TRAIN LOO estimate is 0.6241 and the VALIDATION estimate is 0.6784
decision_rule.prespecified_comparator: the unregularised covariance direction at the same site and layer, fit on the same population. VALIDATION: F5 +0.6784 vs comparator +0.6135. F5 is claimed to BEAT it; if rho_test(F5) <= rho_test(comparator) the regularisation claim is NOT CONFIRMED even if F5 itself is significant.

things_that_must_not_be_said: that F5 predicts ASR -- it predicts INSTALLATION, the model's own semantic report. CONT-ENTRY 049/050 stand: the installation->ASR dissociation is qualitative, not quantitative.
that F5 is a BOMB representation -- the successor phase refuted that reading and nothing here revives it.
that F5 is localised at the codeword -- cw_demo_mean is a MEAN over demonstration codeword rows, not a single site, and no localisation test has been run on it.
that a confirmed rho licenses a causal claim -- this is a predictive fit, and the only causal evidence in the phase is the knockout, which moved ASR by +0.0030, CI [-0.030,+0.036].
single_read: TEST is read ONCE under this document. If the run errors, the error and its cause are recorded and the read still counts.
